title: Text to number checks the exponent range even when the mantissa is zero
statement: Converting text to a number, measured through ABS, rejects a zero mantissa with an out-of-range exponent: ABS("0e-309") is #VALUE! though the text denotes 0, and ABS("0e-308") is 0. The exponent counts as written, less the fraction digits, less 2 for a percent sign, so ABS("0.0e309") is 0, ABS("0e309") is #VALUE!, and ABS("0e-307%") is #VALUE!.
basis: About 120 recorded zero-mantissa cases through ABS.
inferred: The exponent formula is inferred, though it fits every reading; that other functions share this conversion is inferred.

correct.how: The text denotes zero: a zero mantissa is 0 at any exponent.
